scientific_principle: STRUCTURE → ENGINE_V1_PREDICTION → IMMUTABLE_FREEZE → EXPERIMENT → EXPERIMENTAL_RESULT → COMPARISON
forbidden: use internal data to improve current predictions

cohort_rules.diversity_requirement: Prefer different chemical series over identical analogs

required: compound_version_id must be registered in compounds table
structure must be processable by CHEM_STANDARDIZER_V1
compound must belong to an internal research project (not test/scaffold)
excluded: pure test compounds created for system testing
scaffold-only or fragment-only entries without full structure
compounds where InChIKey or canonical_smiles is unavailable

endpoint_eligibility.note: MODEL_UNAVAILABLE endpoints recorded as COVERAGE_GAP only

BLINDED_RETROSPECTIVE.definition: experimental result existed historically but was hidden during prediction freeze; blinding is documented

HISTORICAL_VISIBLE.definition: experimental result was visible to prediction/model development team
HISTORICAL_VISIBLE.note: Retrospective context only — must NOT be described as prospective

endpoint_compatibility_classification.DIRECT_MATCH: Primary quantitative metrics — same endpoint, same unit, compatible assay
endpoint_compatibility_classification.DETERMINISTIC_UNIT_TRANSFORM: Primary quantitative metrics — mathematically equivalent unit conversion
endpoint_compatibility_classification.ASSAY_CONTEXT_LIMITED: Secondary evidence only — assay context incompletely documented
endpoint_compatibility_classification.ENDPOINT_MISMATCH: Excluded from primary metrics — incompatible endpoints

duplicate_handling: Retain all raw replicates. Aggregate per protocol before pairing. Never cherry-pick.
replicate_handling: Retain all replicate_ids. Use robust aggregation (median for regression, majority vote for binary) defined in protocol before pairing.

censor_handling.rule: Censored observations excluded from primary quantitative metrics. Used in directional/censored sensitivity analysis only.

unit_normalization.solubility: log10(mol/L) — convert if needed (1 mg/mL ≈ 1/MW mol/L → log10)
unit_normalization.ppb: % bound — convert fu to % bound: % bound = (1 - fu) * 100

prediction_freeze_rules.freeze_before_experiment: MANDATORY — prediction freeze timestamp must precede experimental result availability
prediction_freeze_rules.freeze_immutability: Prediction freeze rows are APPEND_ONLY — never overwritten
prediction_freeze_rules.blinding_enforcement: Experimental values are NOT readable during prediction freeze registration

bootstrap.small_n_policy: Report data_insufficiency_flag=true instead of fake precision

minimum_n_reporting_rules.regression_metrics: N >= 5 required for primary metric report
minimum_n_reporting_rules.classification_metrics: N >= 5 per class required for AUROC; N >= 10 overall for MCC
minimum_n_reporting_rules.series_analysis: N >= 3 compounds per series for within-series Spearman

decision_rules.note: C or D does NOT automatically modify Engine v1. No automatic acceptance thresholds.

no_automatic_thresholds: No post-hoc favorable threshold creation. Report observed performance and uncertainty.
